questions.question: Which description fits the **Encounter** resource?
options: An interaction between a patient and healthcare provider(s) for the purpose of providing healthcare service(s) or assessing the health status of a patient.
An association between a patient and an organization / healthcare provider(s) during which time encounters may occur.
A list is a curated collection of resources.
Prospective warnings of potential issues when providing care to the patient.
questions.explanation: **Encounter**: An interaction between a patient and healthcare provider(s) for the purpose of providing healthcare service(s) or assessing the health status of a patient. The other descriptions belong to **EpisodeOfCare**, **List**, **Flag**.

questions.question: Which resource would you use? A patient’s visit to the emergency department this morning.
questions.explanation: **Encounter**. An interaction between patient and provider: a visit, admission or telehealth call.

questions.question: You know **Encounter**. Which resource should you use instead when you need “the planned booking before the visit”?
questions.explanation: **Appointment**: the planned booking before the visit. **Encounter** is for something else: An interaction between a patient and healthcare provider(s) for the purpose of providing healthcare service(s) or assessing the health status of a patient.

questions.question: Which element is **required** (minimum cardinality 1) in every **Encounter** instance?
questions.explanation: The required top-level elements of Encounter are `status` (1..1), `class` (1..1). The other options have a minimum cardinality of 0, so they are optional.

questions.question: Which element of **Encounter** is a **modifier** (?!), so receiving systems must not ignore it?
questions.explanation: Modifier elements of Encounter: `status`. `status`: planned | arrived | triaged | in-progress | onleave | finished | cancelled +. A modifier can change the meaning of the whole resource: for example, a status of `entered-in-error` means the data must not be used.
